target_customer: Pharma partners and investors in aging therapeutics; patients with age related disease in the long run
problem: Aging drives chronic disease but few drug programs screen for lifespan extension directly across multiple pathways.
business_model: Biotech drug discovery, small molecule therapeutics for aging and chronic disease, funded by equity

founders.name: Simon Melov
prior_employers: Buck Institute for Research on Aging
founders.background_notes: Buck Institute scientist per Longevity.Technology; listed as CEO in company profiles.

prior_employers: Buck Institute for Research on Aging
founders.background_notes: Crunchbase lists a role as CEO and President of the Buck Institute.

founders.name: Mark Lucanic
prior_employers: Buck Institute for Research on Aging
founders.background_notes: Described as co-founder and CTO in company profile snippets.

competitors.name: Unity Biotechnology
competitors.what: Senolytic medicines for diseases of aging
competitors.traction_then: Raised IPO of $85M in May 2018 after a Series C
competitors.funding_then: More than $200M equity by 2018-03 including a $55M Series C

technical_complexity.rationale: Screening compounds for lifespan in worms and validating in mice is research grade work with long timelines before human data.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary screening data and lab expertise from the Buck Institute, but off patent lead compounds weaken IP.

market_need_then: Aging biotech drew rising investor interest in 2018, with funds such as Unity raising large rounds, though no approved lifespan drugs existed.

branding.name_origin: A source says gerostate means the physiological outcome of aging and alpha signals the best possible outcome of that process.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific; interview title Our phenotype is lifespan

branding.brand_signature: The phrase Our phenotype is lifespan
branding.community_and_virality: Longevity press coverage and a Wefunder campaign with 465 investors.

brand_strength.rationale: Known in the longevity niche through press and crowdfunding, with a name that is unusual but obscure to general audiences.

outcome_analysis: Gerostate Alpha spun out of Buck Institute scientists in 2018 to screen compounds for lifespan extension, ran a Wefunder crowdfunding campaign in 2021 and reported a seed round. The YC page and Altss list it as inactive while its own profiles still describe active work, and the last SEC filing a directory notes was April 2022. Whether it stopped and why is not public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: No company website listed.
